pages.lesson:
LESSON: INTENSIVE READING 4.4.1 PLAY: IDENTIFICATION OF CHARACTERS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.4: Intensive Reading 4.4.1 Play: Identification of Characters

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Intensive Reading 4.4.1 Play: Identification of Characters. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How can one tell the qualities of a character in a play?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the characters in a play
2. use appropriate adjectives to describe the characters
3. describe the actions of the characters using appropriate adverbs

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify the characters in a play
   In simple words: practise until you can identify the characters in a play. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. use appropriate adjectives to describe the characters
   In simple words: practise until you can use appropriate adjectives to describe the characters. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. describe the actions of the characters using appropriate adverbs
   In simple words: practise until you can describe the actions of the characters using appropriate adverbs. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Intensive Reading 4.4.1 Play: Identification of Characters using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Intensive Reading 4.4.1 Play: Identification of Characters in the examples.
2. Explain Intensive Reading 4.4.1 Play: Identification of Characters to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Intensive Reading 4.4.1 Play: Identification of Characters.
4. Show that you can: identify the characters in a play

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Intensive Reading 4.4.1 Play: Identification of Characters using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Intensive Reading 4.4.1 Play: Identification of Characters important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. List the characters and their roles in a play,
2. Role play various characters,
3. Participate in a reader’s theatre as they read sections of a play,
4. Describe the actions of the characters using various adverbs,
5. Relate the characters in a play to people in real life,

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can one tell the qualities of a character in a play?
2. How does describing actions of characters aid our understanding of a play?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the characters in a play
2. use appropriate adjectives to describe the characters
3. describe the actions of the characters using appropriate adverbs

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
